body.base_revision: integer >= 0 or null; OPTIONAL during the transition (absent = legacy last-write-wins, logged). Will become required (428) only after the save-path inventory (S01-INV) and owner approval.

guarantees: no write happens on conflict (schema and revision unchanged)
the client rebases by re-reading GET draft (revision == current_revision) and re-sending with that base_revision after user confirmation

validation.when: base_revision is not an integer >= 0, or the schema is structurally invalid (checked before the lock)
